newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA says no January board meeting scheduled.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA says no January board meeting scheduled.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) has no plans to hold a meeting of its policy-making board in January, a spokesman said on Thursday.
"There is no meeting on the agenda," said the spokesman.
He was responding to market rumours the board had already held, or would hold, a special meeting this month to discuss another easing in official cash rates.
The board does not normally meet in January but rumours had been rife it had met in secret Tuesday to sanction a cut for the day after.
The bank took the unusual step of denying that on Wednesday, but dealers said talk still persisted that a meeting would be held before the scheduled date of February 4.
